prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A cinematic nighttime scene set on a quiet city street, featuring a grand, historic European apartment building as the central subject. The building is illuminated by the soft, warm glow of interior lights shining through multiple windows, contrasting with the cool, bluish tones of the exterior stone facade. Ornate architectural details such as balconies, columns, and decorative moldings are visible, adding a sense of old-world elegance. In the foreground, slightly out of focus, a man with short dark hair and casual clothing is seen from behind, his arm extended as he points emphatically toward the building, creating a sense of urgency or discovery. The camera angle is low and dynamic, looking up at both the man and the building, enhancing the scale and drama of the scene. A streetlamp casts a pool of cold white light, contributing to the moody, atmospheric lighting. The overall style is cinematic, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the background sharp while the foreground figure is blurred, emphasizing the building as the focal point. The color palette balances cool blues and grays with pockets of warm yellow light, evoking a sense of mystery and anticipation.
